subject: Exclusive Summer Sale - Limited Time Only!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our exclusive summer sale happening now! Enjoy up to 50% off on select items including clothing, accessories, and home decor. Don't miss out on this opportunity to upgrade your summer wardrobe or decorate your living space. Hurry, as the sale is for a limited time only! Visit our store or shop online to take advantage of these amazing deals. Happy shopping!
